lines: How long have you been noticing the hair loss?
Where is the thinning: all over, in separate patches, or mainly along the hairline?
It is gradually thinning at my front hairline. There are no separate bald patches.
Have you noticed any changes to your scalp, such as itching or flaking?
I have not noticed itching, flaking, redness or pain on my scalp.
Does anyone in your family have a similar pattern of hair thinning?
My father has a similar pattern of hair thinning.

Hair loss can have different causes, and I cannot tell which applies without an examination. Use a gentle shampoo and conditioner, and let your hair dry naturally. Book a visit for ongoing loss; get checked sooner for sudden patches or a painful, inflamed scalp.

I am worried about my appearance, but can do my usual daily activities.
